name: virtual-meetup-live-e2e
description: Persona-based end-to-end tests that run against the REAL deployed environment (presenter, signed-in attendee, anonymous viewer) across the event lifecycle. Distinct from test/e2e (mocked-local, CI-safe): this suite needs real IVS/Cognito/DynamoDB and disposable Cognito users, so it runs on demand, not in CI.
